title: 2  Preface and Overview
text:
3.1 CDI Omics Systems
CDI Omics Systems is an evolving ecosystem of structured omics workflows designed to connect:

raw biological data
analytical processing
statistical reasoning
interpretation
reproducible reporting

The focus is not only on running tools, but on building complete analytical systems that support transparent and defensible biological insight.

Reproducibility
CDI Omics Systems emphasizes reproducible workflows through transparent analytical pipelines, version-controlled environments, and structured reporting.

title: Appendix
text:
Workflow Philosophy
CDI Omics Systems focuses on:

systems over isolated outputs
interpretation-first analysis
reproducible reporting
transparent analytical reasoning
